text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I have a feeling I should take an 
umbrella before heading out today."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My premonition and the voice of destiny 
were both right! Destiny really is always 
guiding me toward the good—

text_block_list.name: Young Brother and Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Eek! It's so cold, Big Bro..." "J-Just 
put on my jacket for now...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this was the destiny awaiting 
me. —Achoo!
